post_clip.description: A person is repeatedly striking the glass storefront window with their fist or hand in a forceful manner across multiple frames (e.g., frames at 6.5s–9.5s), consistent with vandalism—specifically, attempting to break or damage the window while it stands. No entry into the building occurs; the action is external and targeted at property.

A person enters the frame at 22.5s and approaches the storefront window; by 28.5s, they are positioned directly in front of the glass, leaning forward with hands near or on the window—suggesting imminent or ongoing vandalism (e.g., attempting to break or damage the window). No visible entry into the building, consistent with 'damaging property where it stands'.

The person repeatedly kicks or strikes the lower part of the store's glass window/door frame with their foot (visible in frames around 62.5s–64.5s), consistent with vandalism—damaging property where it stands. No entry attempt is observed; the action is directed at the fixed structure.
